 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Kaushik Goswami
 Order
Date : 09.04.2025 Heard Mr. A. Dutta, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr.
P.S. Lahkar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State respondent.
This criminal petition is directed against the order dated 22.08.2019 for taking cognizance and also the order dated 27.09.2022, whereby the charge was framed against the petitioners under Sections 294/420/506/34 of IPC.
Issue notice, returnable in 3 (three) weeks.
Mr. P.S. Lahkar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of respondent No.1.
Extra copies shall be furnished within a period of 3 (three) days from today.

Steps be taken by registered post with A/D in respect of respondent No.2 within a period of 3 (three)
days from today.
Let scan copy of the TCR be called for by the Registry.
List the matter after 3 (three) weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
Page No.# 3/3 Interim to be considered after the receipt of the TCR.
